content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for PDKV Supporting Staff (Field Man) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Supporting Staff (Field Man) under the AICRP on Agroforestry project at Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth, Akola.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the position of Supporting Staff (Field Man) in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The mode of application is a Walk-in interview. Candidates are required to appear in person at the designated venue on the specified date and time.

faq.question: Q4. What is the walk-in date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 15 October 2026. Candidates should report at 11:00 A.M. onwards.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Diploma in Agriculture from an Agriculture Technical School to be eligible for the Supporting Staff (Field Man) position.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for this post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 38 years. However, age relaxation is provided up to 45 years for candidates belonging to SC, ST, NT, and OBC categories.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary package?
faq.answer: The salary is calculated as Basic Rs. 19900/- plus applicable DA, HRA, and TA, minus 10% of the total pay, resulting in a total consolidated pay.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the interview venue?
faq.answer: The interview will be conducted at the office of the Sr. Scientist & O/I, AICRP on Agroforestry, College of Agriculture, Nagpur, Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for the Supporting Staff (Field Man) recruitment at Dr. PDKV.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the interview?
faq.answer: You must carry original documents and self-attested copies of your Date of Birth proof, educational qualifications, experience certificates (if any), and a No Objection Certificate from your current employer.
